ruledOut: advisor_recommend is not stale: the frozen front-door contract lists it first of nine commands with snake/kebab/camel spellings, and the built CLI contains it.
system-spec-kit SKILL.md section 3 still holds the declared-loss sentence after the router split.

label: AGENTS.md Gate 2 tells the agent to load what 'the router resolves' but never names ROUTER.md, the sibling file v4.0.1.0 made the mandatory home of every skill's intent tables, resource maps and pseudocode; proposed one-line edit at AGENTS.md:70.
No path, command or section anchor cited by AGENTS.md is stale after v4.0.1.0: 20 filesystem probes and 11 anchor probes all resolved, so no repair edit is needed on that surface.

The four v4.0.1.0 retirements (sk-vision and /vision, mcp-magicpath, sk-design-fundamentals, the GPT-6 gateway routes) plus the .skilled/release removal have zero matches across AGENTS.md, REPO RULES.md and all 13 repo rules, so no rule text needs deleting.

Decision capture, render checks and the doc rewrite guard are already owned downstream (save-workflow.md writes operatorDecisions into decision-record.md; sk-doc's ROUTER.md carries the RENDER_LEDGER intent Gate 2 routes to), so restating them in AGENTS.md would duplicate an owner and no edit is warranted.

No CLAUDE.md exists at the repo root or under .claude/, so the topic's 'AGENTS.md which CLAUDE.md mirrors' premise is unverified; AGENTS.md is the root instruction file that /doctor:agents-md manages.

Only two of the 13 repo rules changed anywhere in v4.0.0.16..v4.0.1.0 (communication-handoff.md, 4 lines; skill-hub-routing.md, 8 lines), and AGENTS.md's only in-range commit added the section manifest and repository block, so the rules layer absorbed the router move while AGENTS.md did not.

The primary pre-commit enforces comment hygiene over staged blobs with SPECKIT_SKIP_COMMENT_HYGIENE=1 as a bypass and does not run doc-rewrite-guard.py, so the AGENTS.md Comment Hygiene hard block is not redundant with it.
Where AGENTS.md and the repo-rules layer both describe routing tables, they must name the same file: the sibling ROUTER.md, not the SKILL.md copy.
